2226-2397-2950.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2397-2950.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Panharmonicon.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Aven Surveyor by paying its mana cost.
When Aven Surveyor enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

4222-4474-8230.easyPrerequisites: Seedship Agrarian doesn't have summoning sickness.
4222-4474-8230.description:
Activate Seedship Agrarian by tapping it, adding {U}.
Seedship Agrarian triggers, creating a Lander token
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Seedship Agrarian.
Repeat.

uses.n: Esika, God of the Tree // The Prismatic Bridge

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2158-3249-6073--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2158-3249-6073--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Esika by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Angelic Sell-Sword triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3175-3899-4775.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

341-4200-5998-6867.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-5078-6768-7753.notablePrerequisites: Uthros Research Craft has at least 12 charge counters on it.
3532-5078-6768-7753.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Diving Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a charge counter from Uthros Research Craft.
Uthros Research Craft triggers, putting a charge counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

255-413-7124.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
255-413-7124.description:
Declare The Incredible Hulk and Stangg as attackers.
Stangg triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a creature token, dealing 1 damage to The Incredible Hulk.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, then untapping it and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1978-5793-7685.description:
Animate Arc Reactor using Bello.
Activate Arc Reactor by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Arc Reactor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3738-5147-6972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sightless Ghoul
When Sightless Ghoul dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sightless Ghoul
When Sightless Ghoul dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
3738-5147-6972.notes: If Sightless Ghoul starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

6899-7407.easyPrerequisites: Inviolability and With Great Power... are attached to the same creature.
6899-7407.description:
Whenever damage would be dealt to you, With Great Power... causes that damage to be redirected to the creature it is attached to.
Since Inviolability grants an ability to the creature preventing damage being dealt to it, no damage is dealt to you or to that creature.

2034-5086-5183-6441-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-5086-5183-6441-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

141-2906-7101.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
141-2906-7101.description:
Cast Airbending Lesson by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Rakdos.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Airbending Lesson targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Airbending Lesson, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Rakdos.
Repeat from step 3.

1687-2438-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1687-2438-5972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

277-1671-5702-6850.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
277-1671-5702-6850.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber. When it enters, Tiller Engine, Simic Growth Chamber and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Simic Growth Chamber.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Icetill Explorer.
Because of the additional Icetill Explorer token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

1289-5078-5864-6918.notablePrerequisites: Birds of Paradise does not have summoning sickness.
1289-5078-5864-6918.description:
Activate Birds of Paradise by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Valley Floodcaller triggers, giving Birds, Otters, Frogs and Rats you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Repeat.

4419-5641-6012.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Reluctant Role Model's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

1497-1912-5217-6006.description:
Activate Order of Whiteclay by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Order of Whiteclay by paying {W}{W} and untapping it, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2043-4365-4659-6671.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

573-719-1399-1606.description:
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Gruul Turf.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

628-5686-6487.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Canker Abomination.
When Canker Abomination dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Canker Abomination enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a number of -1/-1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures an opponent controls.
If the opponent had seven or more creatures, Canker Abomination will die as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness. If this occurs, repeat steps 2 through 4 infinitely.
Otherwise, resolve the Shilgengar ability, and repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

3097-3490-4659-5332.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

1140-1636-3143-6168.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1140-1636-3143-6168.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Obuun trigger.
Resolve the Obuun trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

2933-4094-4499.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
2933-4094-4499.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Pakpatiq, Deepest Epoch // Temple of Cyclical Time

2438-5550-5551.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
2438-5550-5551.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Pakpatiq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Pakpatiq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 4.

292-3587-5358.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal exactly 1 or 2 damage to Boros Reckoner.
292-3587-5358.description:
Deal exactly 1 or 2 damage to Boros Reckoner.
Rite of Passage and Boros Reckoner trigger twice.
Resolve both Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Boros Reckoner.
Resolve the first Boros Recknoer trigger, dealing damage equal to the damage dealt to it to any target.
Resolve the second Boros Reckoner trigger, dealing damage equal to the damage dealt to it to itself.
Repeat from step 2.

2498-3859-4691.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2498-3859-4691.description:
Activate Cavern Harpy by paying 1 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat as desired.
Resolve all Cavern Harpy abilities.

50-2060-3525-4260.notablePrerequisites:
Ballynock Trapper does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Ballynock Trapper.
An opponent controls an untapped creature.
50-2060-3525-4260.description:
Activate Ballynock Trapper by tapping it, tapping a creature an opponent controls.
Solitary Sactuary triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Ballynock Trapper.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop during each turn.

2347-2645-3918.notablePrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
2347-2645-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn the Infinite using Firemind Vessel's ability by tapping it, adding two mana of differing colors.
Activate Trazyn the Infinite using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate any of Staff of Domination's abilities using Trazyn the Infinite.

186-3371-4019.notablePrerequisites:
Codie does not have summoning sickness.
Codie has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
186-3371-4019.description:
Activate Codie by paying {3} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {U}, untapping Codie.
Repeat.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, you may cast any instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each instant and/or sorcery card in your hand, and on subsequent turns.

751-3314-5033.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the Island to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put the basic Island onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

411-969-3286.description:
Activate Grinning Ignus by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it to your hand from the battlefield, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {2}{R}.
Inga and Esika triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1020-3689-4659-4947.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Workshop Assistant, adding {C}{C}.
Workshop Assistant dies, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Thopter and Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Myr Retriever dies, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {3}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

319-4447.notablePrerequisites:
Assault Suit attached to Phylactery Lich.
A player does not control a permanent with a phylactery counter on it.
319-4447.description:
If needed, give control of Phylactery Lich to an opponent who controls no permanents with a phylactery counter on them.
When Phylactery Lich's controller controls no permanents with a phylactery counter on them, Phylactery Lich triggers, causing them to sacrifice it.
However, Phylactery Lich cannot be sacrificed due to Assault Suit.
Phylactery Lich triggers again, creating a mandatory infinite loop that causes the game to end in a draw.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1017-2122-4772.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Doubling Season
Repeat.

1308-3129-3209-4772.description:
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback for {4}{G}, creating eight 1/1 green Saproling token.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback, tapping five green 1/1 Saproling tokens to pay for it using convoke.
Repeat from step 2.

2836-3367.notablePrerequisites:
You have no cards in your graveyard.
You have a way to draw a card.
2836-3367.description:
Cast Paradigm Shift by paying {1}{U}, exiling your library and shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Draw a card, causing you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.

364-1964-1987-2493.description:
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Archaeomancer, blinking them.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

65-717-1583-2628-5181.description:
Activate Drifting Meadow's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Drifting Meadow, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Drifting Meadow trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Golgari Findbroker.
Golgari Findbroker enters the battlefield, returning Drifting Meadow from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
